title: Lychee cake near Quakers Hill or Kellyville Ridge? 100% eggless, Riverstone
summary:
Lychee cake without eggs, made to order at Riverstone Shopping Centre. Light sponge, lychee cream, nothing that needs checking first.

If you live in Quakers Hill, Kellyville Ridge or Marsden Park and keep asking bakeries whether the cake has egg in it, this is the answer: every cake here is 100% eggless. No exceptions, which is why you can stop asking.

A 6-inch from $39.99 serves 6-8. An 8-inch from $49.99 serves 12-14. Order 2 days ahead. Collect from Shop 8, with free parking at the centre. Weekdays from 6am, weekends from 7am.

Message us your size and the day you need it.
